lines.1: 「Otome was the one who made my heart race most.」
lines.4: 「That is how it stands. Do you understand, Princess?」
lines.5: 「At his age, it is only natural for an older woman's charms to leave him helpless. Do not blame Leo.」
lines.6: Otome placed her hand on the Princess's head and patted it.
lines.8: The jock teasingly tugged the Princess's ponytail back and forth.
